filter_find_queries_by_text: filter find queries in a datapoint by excluding specific query text keys
keep_max_num_find_queries: keep at most N find queries per datapoint, optionally retaining positive queries
filter_datapoint_queries: filter and remap find queries, objects, and images in a SAM3 datapoint
transform_text_query_to_visual: transform text-based find queries into visual queries using bounding box prompts
add_prefix_suffix_to_find_text: add prefix or suffix strings to find query text with optional conditional filtering
